point.start: Point an element of the page and say what to change

pointPanel.title: Pointed elements
pointPanel.description: Say what to change about each element. Each one goes to the task as a message: its next session gets the element, its place in the page and the files that probably render it.
pointPanel.placeholder: For example: this button should be disabled while the cart is empty
pointPanel.noSource: No file of the task contains this element: the agent will search for it
pointPanel.send_other: Send the {{count}} elements to the agent
pointPanel.sent_one: Sent: the next session of the task gets it.
pointPanel.sent_other: {{count}} elements sent: the next session of the task gets them.

errors.generic: The element could not be pointed.
errors.no_preview: The preview is not ready yet: wait for the page to load.
errors.devtools_open: Close the preview's DevTools first: they hold the page.
errors.pick_in_progress: An element is already being pointed in this preview.
errors.pick_failed: The page did not answer: reload it and point again.
errors.local_only: Pointing works on tasks of this computer only.
errors.task_done: The task is finished: there is no next session to send to.
errors.element_not_found: This element is no longer kept: point it again.
errors.empty_message: Say what to change about each element.
errors.queue_unwritable: The task's folder could not be written.

matrix.intro: Each checked device renders {{path}} from the emulator's server, one after the other, then the page is read for responsive bugs.
matrix.introRoot: The page shown is not on the emulator's server: the matrix renders the server root.
matrix.empty: Check devices, then capture: each one appears here side by side.

errors.unknown-device: This device is not in the catalogue.
errors.not-running: The emulator's server is not running: start it, then capture again.
errors.invalid-path: This address is not a page of the emulator's server.

errors.load-failed: The page did not load on this device in time.

errors.unknown-throttling: This throttling profile is not in the list.

errors.session-failed: The preview's session could not be read: capture again without it.
errors.unknown-persona: This persona no longer exists: choose another session.
errors.persona-locked: The persona's cookies could not be decrypted (system keyring locked or changed): save it again.
errors.persona-elsewhere: This persona was saved for another server: it is only replayed on that host.

report.unavailable: The page could not be read for responsive bugs.
report.pageOverflow: The page is {{px}} px wider than the screen: it scrolls sideways.

issues.truncatedText_one: {{count}} text is cut off or spills out of its box
issues.truncatedText_other: {{count}} texts are cut off or spill out of their box
issues.brokenNavigation_one: {{count}} navigation cannot be reached on mobile
issues.brokenNavigation_other: {{count}} navigations cannot be reached on mobile

throttling.hint: Applied to the next capture: a throttled page loads as it would on that connection or that slower processor.

exportErrors.nothing-to-export: No capture to export: capture devices first.

exportErrors.export-failed: The grid image could not be built.
exportErrors.write-failed: The image could not be written where you chose.

matrix.previewSessionHint: The cookies the preview sends to this server are lent to each capture, so a page behind a sign-in shows as you see it. Local storage is not shared.
matrix.auto: Shown for the review of this task: its changes touch the interface.

custom.hint: Kept on this computer. The width and height are in CSS pixels; the app checks every field before emulating it.
custom.name: Name
custom.mobile: Mobile browser (applies the viewport meta tag)
custom.invalid: Check the fields: width and height from 240 to 3840 px, pixel ratio from 1 to 4, a name of 1 to 40 characters, a user agent in plain ASCII (512 characters at most).

errors.too-many: 20 devices at most: remove one first.

scan.title: Breakpoints
scan.intro: Reads the page, on the chosen device, at common widths and one pixel on each side of every width breakpoint its style sheets declare.
scan.running: Reading the page at each width…
scan.none: No width breakpoint in the style sheets the page can read.

live.hint: Each checked device shows the live page. Moving in one moves the others; the dev server reloads them all when the code changes.
live.capped: {{count}} live views at most: the first {{count}} checked devices are shown.
live.empty: Check devices to see them live, side by side.
